name: gss-ntlmssp
why: Opens a door into NTLM authentication inside GSSAPI, an old Windows auth handshake most people never see.

brief.what_it_is: gss-ntlmssp is a mechglue plugin for the GSSAPI library that implements NTLM authentication. It plugs into a GSSAPI installation so that programs using the standard GSSAPI calls can authenticate with the NTLM handshake, the older Windows challenge-response scheme. The README says it has been built and tested only against the libgssapi from MIT Kerberos, version 1.11 or later. The README does not describe a standalone command-line tool.
brief.why_it_exists: The README gives no explicit problem statement. It says the project was made much simpler by Samba's work and by Microsoft's MS-NLMP protocol documentation, which suggests the goal is NTLM support under GSSAPI, where it was not otherwise available.
brief.how_it_works: It is a mechglue plugin, so GSSAPI's mechanism-glue layer loads it as one of several authentication mechanisms behind the common GSSAPI interface. It implements the NTLM message exchange as specified in MS-NLMP. The README does not go into further detail on the mechanism.
brief.install_notes: The README gives no build or install steps; these are not in the README and the wiki home page does not include them. It requires an MIT Kerberos libgssapi of version 1.11 or newer. Releases are on the GitHub Releases page, and the wiki links to an older Pagure release page. Contribution guidance is on a contributions page linked from the wiki.
brief.standout: It brings NTLM, a Windows authentication protocol most people never see, into the GSSAPI framework through the mechglue plugin mechanism rather than as a separate library. The OID space 1.3.6.1.4.1.7165.655.1.x was donated by the Samba Project, which is an unusual detail.
brief.status: unknown. The GitHub README has a build badge but no release date or version. The wiki home page was last edited by Simo Sorce on Apr 1, 2022, and it points to a Releases page I did not fetch. I did not see a last commit date or latest release date, so I cannot say whether it is actively maintained.
brief.caveats: The README says it has been built and tested only with MIT Kerberos libgssapi 1.11 and above, so other GSSAPI implementations are untested. NTLM is an older, weaker protocol than Kerberos, and the README does not discuss security trade-offs. The wiki asks that security issues be emailed to simo@redhat.com rather than opened as public issues. The brew formula has no caveats.
quotes: This is a mechglue plugin for the GSSAPI library that implements NTLM authentication.
So far it has been built and tested only with the libgssapi implementation that comes with MIT Kerberos (Versions 1.11 and above)
The project is currently distributed under the permissive ISC license, see the COPYING file in the root directory.
